$description: ReviewFlow (platform/patterns/ReviewFlow), library wave 10, lane B: its pattern tokens. The review panel’s head (title, detail and status), its sections and their labels, the reviewers, the comment and the decisions, and the review queue’s gap; the statuses are Badge’s variants, the history is ActivityList.

review-flow-gap.$description: ReviewFlow: gap between the panel’s parts (space-stack-lg).

review-flow-head-gap.$description: ReviewFlow: gap between the title and the status badge, and a reviewer and their decision (space-inline-md).

review-flow-section-gap.$description: ReviewFlow: gap between a section’s label and its content, and the comment and the decisions (space-stack-sm).

review-flow-reviewer-min-height.$description: ReviewFlow: a reviewer row’s least height (size-28px).

review-flow-waiting-text.$description: ReviewFlow: Waiting color (a reviewer with no decision yet) (content-muted).

review-flow-actions-gap.$description: ReviewFlow: gap between the decision buttons (space-inline-sm).

review-flow-queue-gap.$description: ReviewFlow: ReviewQueue: gap between the command bar and the table (space-stack-sm).
